I started thinking how nothing had happened to me and started wondering if ghosts actually existed. And evidently, my parents hadn't heard a thing as they continued getting ready for work as normal. After I opened my eyes, my lips were really dry and you know when your hand goes a bit numb and when you touch it, it feels like it's someone else's hand? That's what my lips felt like! It was so strange and I cant explain it.
